newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales-private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle bids near midday Tuesday at $105.00 per cwt on a dressed basis were passed by owners asking $107.00, livestock sources said.
Last sales were at $105.00 to $106.00 in brisk trading last week.
Owners also were pricing cattle at $67.00 on a live basis, but not finding bids. Sales last week had a top of $66.00.
Fed cattle prices this week were expected to be lifted by strong beef values and smaller numbers of cattle on showlists compared with last week, the sources said.
